findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子承認所服務市場技術快速變動、新產品頻繁推出，並點名 AI 技術與資料中心基礎設施需求是需successfully整合/定位的領域；未點名特定替代技術取代核心產品。
findings.excerpt: The markets we serve are characterized by rapidly changing technologies and frequent introductions of new products and services. Our ability to develop new products based on technological innovation and to position our existing products in new markets can affect our competitive position and often requires the investment of significant resources.

findings.claim: 第三方分析稱行動設備電動化可能以機電系統取代液壓，時間尺度約 10–15 年；液壓約占 Industrial 部門 25–30%（第三方估計）。
findings.source: PitchGrade research: parker hannifin ai margin pressure
findings.excerpt: The company is the world's leading diversified manufacturer of motion and control technologies — hydraulics, pneumatics, electromechanical systems, filtration, and fluid management products — with over 100,000 SKUs serving industrial, mobile, and aerospace markets across virtually every geography and end market.

findings.claim: Simply Wall St 社群敘事：看空者擔心電動化與軟體化自動化侵蝕傳統液壓。
findings.source: Simply Wall St narrative: global electrification will challenge legacy markets

substitute_technology.note: 第三方網站（PitchGrade、StockAlarm、Simply Wall St）提到行動設備液壓被機電取代的長期風險，但搜尋摘要無可逐字複製原文，列於 clues；未找到 Parker 自己量化的液壓受衝擊營收。 線索 2 條，程式核實 1 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
